title: Art in America Magazine January 1988 Symposium The Musee d'Orsay Matt Mullican
descriptionText: Art in America Magazine January 1988 Symposium The Musee d'Orsay Matt Mullican is a collectible publication that offers an insightful look into the art world. This issue features a symposium on the Musee d'Orsay and an interview with Matt Mullican. It was published in January 1988 in the United States and is written in English. The magazine falls under the category of Art & Photography and covers various art topics. It is a valuable resource for art enthusiasts and collectors alike.
